metadata.scenario: A new customer calls to report that the technician who came for the appliance repair left the job unfinished. They are dissatisfied with the service and want to speak with a manager. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Jennifer Taylor. I’m calling because I’m quite unhappy with the service we received recently. I’m sorry to hear that, Jennifer. Can you please tell me more about the issue? Well, we had a technician come out for some appliance repairs, but they left the job unfinished, and I’d like to speak with a manager about it. I understand your frustration. Let me see what I can do to help you with this. I really appreciate that. It’s just been very inconvenient, and I’d like some answers. Absolutely, I can get a manager for you. Can you hold for just a moment? Sure, I can wait. Thank you for your patience. I’ll connect you with Angela Martinez, our Client Services Manager. One moment, please. Angela, this is Margaret. I have Jennifer Taylor on the line regarding an unfinished service issue. Hi Angela, I’m really upset about the technician who came for repairs. They left my grandmother’s appliance unfinished. The washing machine isn’t working at all now. They didn’t fix it, and it’s been days! That would be great. Can you also update me on when that might happen? Thank you, that would be very helpful. Well, actually, my grandmother could use some companion care and help with daily activities. That sounds good, thank you. Thank you for your call, Jennifer. We’ll get this resolved for you. I appreciate your help, Angela. You’re welcome! Transferring you now. [transferring to Lisa]
